'''Stomper One''' was a [[Void Jumper]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Marines]] who participated in the [[assault on the New Jedi Temple]]. Alongside [[Stomper Two]], the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] spearheaded the charge of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] and [[Sergeant major/Legends|Sergeant Major]] [[Gef Olazon]]'s forces through the [[New Jedi Temple]]'s corridors against [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] opponents led by [[Abeloth]].
